Rajiv Sinha: quick RFC follow-up: we need a compact spec for "precision profiles" that covers full-stack concerns: model catalog, endpoint overrides, per-tenant deltas, and runtime fallback rules. current config bits are fragmented.
Marta Li: +1. main pain: cache keys and audits. runtime currently uses JSON blob hashing which is brittle.
Rajiv Sinha: proposal: canonical envelope 'quant_profile' with fields: id, fingerprint, family (compat groups), patches[], and a light 'safety_policy' that expresses acceptable quality deltas and fallback targets. example (pseudo):
```json
{
  "quant_profile": "id:fp8.chat.v1; fingerprint:ab12; family:fp8-int8; patches:[tenant:foo->head4:int4]; safety_policy:fail_on_divergence=0.12,fallback=int8"
}
```
Oscar G.: compatibility families are smart. if kernels share KV layout we can allow hot transitions; otherwise convert once and emit conversion_cost metric. we should enumerate families in runtime docs.
Nina Park: ops ask: migration path? we must accept old flat keys and synthesize canonical objects. plan: canary parser that ingests legacy fields, migration job to materialize canonical profiles, UI shows canonical merged view with a "legacy raw" toggle for 14 days.
Rajiv Sinha: telemetry: every trace/span should include profile.id and profile.fingerprint. emit events: quant.profile.resolve, quant.profile.fallback, quant.profile.patch_apply. add gauge quant.active_variant per endpoint.
Marta Li: QA: golden-prompt suites per workload bucket (chat/search/summarize) + head-targeted prompts for head-level patches. run small canary (5% traffic) and compare divergence metric (cosine + likelihood delta). threshold per workload.
Oscar G.: runtime: cache_key = sha256(base_id + '|' + sorted(patch_ids) + '|' + fingerprint). keep it short. also support a debug verbose key env. add lint to block ambiguous priority in overrides.
Nina Park: security: patches must be tenant-scoped. private deployments should not resolve public patches. API validator to reject cross-tenant refs. migration tool must tag converted profiles with origin metadata.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: compat parser rolled to canary cluster at 1797777785 :white_check_mark:
Rajiv Sinha: short-term actions: (1) Marta: draft RFC addendum + migration steps; (2) Oscar: proto for patch deltas + cache-key impl; (3) Nina: QA + canary harness and golden sets; (4) infra: add lint + schema validator. I'll collect PR links in the addendum.
Marta Li: will draft and include example workflows for fp8->int8 automatic fallback and for per-head int4 patches.
Oscar G.: will PR a tiny protobuf patch format and unit tests for delta apply/rollback.
Nina Park: scheduling canary perf runs this week. will add a negative test ensuring rollback triggers on intentional degradation.
Rajiv Sinha: thanks, closing thread. will follow up with RFC addendum link when posted.
